title: Padding a machine action
statement: Let $m\le k$, let $a$ be an action of an $m$-work-tape Boolean machine with states in $S$, and let $f$ map optional states in $S$ to optional states in $B$. The padded action on $k$ work tapes keeps the input-head movement and output unchanged, uses $a$'s action on the first $m$ work tapes and leaves the remaining tapes unchanged, and maps the successor state through $f$.
hypotheses_covered: Action on $m$ work tapes over Boolean symbols with states in $S$
